Post 1
⬆️ ASX 200 hit a 20-day high Tuesday, closing at 8,850.10 (+40.20pts, +0.46%). Materials surged +2.78% as small-cap miners ran hard. The index is still 4.80% off its 52-week high — rally or retest? #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
⛏️ Materials led all sectors at +2.78%. A-REITs (+0.78%) and Energy (+0.63%) followed. Financials (-0.59%) and Consumer Discretionary (-0.56%) dragged. Rotation into hard assets, out of rate-sensitive names. #ASX #mining #ausbiz

Post 3
🔺 MP1 surged 9.60% to AUD17.58 — the top ASX 200 mover Tuesday. FFM added 9.30% to AUD1.41. Small-cap materials and tech led the charge while APE fell 4.69% to AUD19.09. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD5,716.75/oz driving Materials sector strength. Silver AUD75.34/oz, Platinum AUD2,141.38/oz, Palladium AUD1,457.05/oz. AUD/USD at 0.7024 amplifying returns for local gold holders. #gold #metals #ASX

Post 5
Watch gold above AUD5,716/oz — if it holds, Materials stays the engine. ASX sits 4.80% off its 52-week high. Does this rally have legs to close the gap, or does the index stall here? Drop your call below. #ASX #ausbiz #gold
